macros.name: Sneaky lock (Tornado pulls a defender, X-Bow locks)
macros.start_condition: own bridge X-Bow placement (y 16..20.5) or X-Bow in hand + >= 6 elixir with an enemy defender (troop / building) inside X-Bow range of the target princess (refined start: defender within 7 tiles of the X-Bow site)

prefix.place: bridge tile of the target lane: (3.5|14.5, 18.5)
on the defender, so its pull moves it out of the X-Bow's line (y < 20, within 11.5 tiles of the X-Bow)
prefix.after_ticks: -120..300 relative to the X-Bow (median measured: see stats)

macros.well: the X-Bow locked (>= 5% of a princess lost in reach during its life; HF: lane proxy)
default_horizon: pays inside ~20 s of lock damage (PLAN P6 mechanism 3)
macros.horizon_basis: measured (margin lift n400 reaches 80% of the max 0.017)

macros.name: Counter-push behind surviving defenders
